name: Open-Meteo historical weather archive (ECMWF ERA5)
covers: Daily maximum, minimum and mean temperature and precipitation for nine points across the Philippines, 31,047 days each from 1 January 1940 to 31 December 2024
note: Reanalysis, not observation: a physical model constrained by whatever measurements existed, on a grid of roughly 25 km. A city here is a grid cell, not a weather station.

name: ECMWF ERA5-Land
covers: The same variables from the higher-resolution land-surface reanalysis, used as an independent check on ERA5
note: Fetched through Open-Meteo. It disagrees with ERA5 by 1.09 °C on Manila's mean temperature and by roughly a factor of two on the warming rate, which is why this page reports a range rather than a number.

name: PAGASA climatological normals
covers: The Philippine authority for station observations and climate normals
note: Cited because it is what should be used and is not. pagasa.dost.gov.ph is not reachable from a script here, and station records are a different measurement from reanalysis.
